_readme: Hand-planned footage montages per ayah, built by scripts/build_montages.py into assets/prerendered/<id>.mp4 and shipped to the GitHub release the daily cloud workflow downloads. Shots reference content/footage.json clip ids; `take` seconds from the clip's `start`, optional `speed` = setpts slow factor. Crossfades are 1.0s. Plans were frame-reviewed before release. NOTE f4 is only clean 0.4-9.0s (pedestrian close-up group enters after — never take more than 8.6s).
